'''Roan Fel's quarters''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. In [[137 ABY]], shortly after [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]]'s [[Operation: Thunderstroke|capture]] by the [[One Sith]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] was informed of her status inside his quarters. Due to the fact that the Princess knew all of the [[Empire-in-exile|Imperial]] codes, as well as the location of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]], Emperor Fel ordered that the Princess must be either rescued or [[Death/Legends|killed]] to prevent her from providing the information under [[Torture/Legends|torture]].<ref name="Legacy (2006) 49">[[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]]</ref>
